go-weave 0.1.0

- Initial release of the unofficial Go client for the W&B Weave trace server API.
- Exposes strongly-typed methods for all 74 Weave endpoints via `*weave.ClientWithResponses`.
- Authenticates with HTTP Basic using `WANDB_USERNAME` and `WANDB_API_KEY` from environment variables.
- Comprehensive support for all trace server operations—including calls, objects, tables, files, feedback, costs, threads, annotation queues, evaluations, and v2 dataset/model endpoints.
- Includes code examples for starting and reading calls.
